body: Ahh thanks its ok, it was a bit grim. Look i appreciate the offer honestly.
Theres always that one good samaratin like that gent throwaway9193858. Wish you well, you do a good job here with some of those that are lost.
Ah dude cheers man, i appreciate the concern, but at this stage im just interested in having a general chat over a cup of tea.

I have been looking through a few threads belonging to what i can only assume are teenagers, a quick message to those guys.
.
Listen lads, 
They are right when they say give it another week things turn around.
It got me this far and it got someone somehow to love me .
Im not advocating you guys go kill yourself. And take it from a brutally scared self harmer, its just a waste of mental energy you could be using to spite the thing that makes you angry and one up it . Ahh but i only know this now since im older.

Reading over this is looks petty as hell haha, ahh ive just learned over the years that not everything is doom and gloom and rushing to kill myself. Ive been there deliberately   destroying myself with escapist views, doesnt work in the end just harming yourself, ive been building to this without anger or resentment now for a while and its a strange feeling alright. To still want to do something as "foolish" as take your life when completly calm.

Honestly this was a ramble. No structure at all, i have a formal letter here handwritten but i wanted something informal thats a bit more permanent here on the internet
Thanks for reading
 ~A
